## Constitution Compliance Checklist
- [ ] **Qt Framework**: Uses signals/slots, Qt types (QString, QList), parent-child ownership
- [ ] **Cross-Platform**: Works on all target platforms, uses QStandardPaths, handles DPI/screen size variations
- [ ] **Resource Management**: All QObjects have parents, resources properly released, null checks implemented
- [ ] **Performance**: UI responsive (<200ms), video maintains 15+ fps, no blocking operations on main thread
- [ ] **Code Quality**: Functions <50 lines, magic numbers replaced with named constants, complex logic commented
